notes.design_decision: The dispatch asked for an OutputTarget opt-in. OutputTarget is a v1 Copy struct built by struct literal in 56 files across 8 crates (composite src/tests, harness view, interop-fig tests, pigment tests, render-cpu/gpu src/examples/tests), several holding other lanes' uncommitted work, so a new field is a breaking change, not additive. The stage therefore lives in the additive envelope that pigment's own extensions.rs header names for exactly this reason: PlanExtensions.output (non_exhaustive, from_layers/with_output). It is part of the plan digest through digest_with; the default stage is skipped in serialisation so every existing digest stays bit-identical (test plan_digest_covers_the_output_stage_and_the_default_is_absent). Moving it into OutputTarget later needs a coordinated literal migration across those crates (lead decision).

notes.mode_review: Rule: a mode is defined above 1 when its pigment formula has no constant 1 (white point), no 0.5 threshold and no clip of its result. Defined: normal/dissolve B=Cs; multiply b*s; darken min; lighten max; difference |b-s|; subtract max(b-s,0); darker/lighter colour choose by channel sum; linear dodge min(1,a+b) whose min is the unit clamp -> a+b. Undefined (refused sample_range_extended_mode): screen b+s-bs, exclusion b+s-2bs, overlay/hard light/soft light (0.5 threshold, 1-terms), colour dodge/burn (1-s, 1-b, min 1), linear burn (a+b-1), vivid/linear/pin light, hard mix (0.5/1 thresholds), divide (saturates at 1), hue/saturation/colour/luminosity (ClipColor clips to [0,1]).
